 Print School holiday today, November 17 Schools in Bihar and Jharkhand will remain closed today, Tuesday, November 17, 2026, on account of Chhath Puja celebrations. However, schools in most other states are expected to follow their regular schedules, as no statewide holiday has been announced for the day. Students and parents should note that school holidays may differ from one district to another. Individual schools and local administrations may also announce holidays depending on regional requirements. Parents are advised to check official school notices before sending their children to school. Here is a state-wise update on school holidays for November 17. Bihar Schools across Bihar will remain closed on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, as per the announced holiday schedule. Students will not have to attend regular classes today. Parents and students should contact their respective schools for information about reopening dates and any changes to the academic calendar. Jharkhand Schools across Jharkhand will also remain closed on account of a regional holiday. Parents and students should check official state and school notifications for confirmation and further details. Delhi Schools across Delhi are expected to remain open, as no statewide school holiday has been announced for the date. Both government and private schools are likely to follow their regular schedules. Uttar Pradesh Schools across Uttar Pradesh are expected to remain open on November 17, as no statewide closure has been confirmed. However, students in different districts should check with their school authorities for any local holiday announcements. Rajasthan Schools across Rajasthan are expected to operate as usual. No statewide school holiday has been announced for the date. West Bengal Schools across West Bengal are expected to remain open on November 17, 2026. However, individual schools may announce a local holiday, so students should check with their respective institutions. Himachal Pradesh Schools across Himachal Pradesh are expected to follow their regular schedules on Tuesday, November 17, as no statewide school holiday has been confirmed. Join conversation

 Odisha Schools across Odisha, including those in Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Puri, Rourkela, Sambalpur and Balasore, are expected to remain open on November 17, 2026. No statewide school closure has been announced for the day. Note: Students and parents should check their respective school websites, official notices or messages from school authorities for the latest holiday information. While Bihar and Jharkhand will observe a school holiday today, schools in other states are likely to continue with their regular classes.
